title: Seventh chords
raisedBecause: Four-note chords split between the hands: the left hand plays the root while the right hand holds three keys, and both must land together; the notes alone measure Beginner.
trains: Four-note chords split between the hands: the left hand plays the root, the right hand the third, fifth and seventh. Cmaj7 (C E G B), C7 (B♭ instead of B), Cm7 (E♭ and B♭) and Bø7 (B D F A, half-diminished).
